crucialFeats: Tags UI Goku a few times.
No sells a Kamehameha from SSB Goku.
Detects and Counters attacks coming from a different dimension.
Is more powerful than his universe God of Destruction.

dossier.advantage: Overwhelming energy barrier and reflexes. His Ki is so powerful that it serves as both an impenetrable defense and the ultimate offense.
dossier.mentality: A stoic absolutist. He fights without unnecessary words or emotions, taking the shortest path to total dominance over the opponent.
dossier.quote: It matters not how many weaklings band together. You are nothing before absolute strength.
dossier.style: Ultra-efficient fighting of pure strength and Ki. He relies on minimal movement and devastating counters that end the fight before the opponent can react.

fighterA.name: Jiren

powers: Extreme ki output, barrier techniques and elite speed/reactions.
tools: Gaze that predicts movements, allowing him to counter before the attack even begins.
weaknesses: Limited utility compared with heavy hax specialists.
Overconfidence in his own invulnerability may delay adaptation to non-linear growth.

crucialFeats: Serious Punch Squared carves a void through space.
A Serious Sneeze blows away the gas surrounding Jupiter.

dossier.advantage: Immeasurable strength and resilience. He has no limits – every strike has finishing potential, and he remains immune to most attacks.
dossier.mentality: A bored and carefree professional. He doesn't take the fight seriously until someone forces him to exert effort, which he waits for with hope.
dossier.quote: 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10km run EVERY SINGLE DAY!!!
dossier.style: Simple, direct punch attacks. His style relies on such massive physical superiority that technique becomes redundant for him.

fighterB.name: Saitama

powers: Extreme physical power, durability, stamina, and growth under prolonged conflict.
tools: Direct close-range offense and rapid adaptation through the fight.
Gag-logic: ability to ignore laws of physics (kicking portals, shifting through space) when the situation requires.
weaknesses: Minimal formal technique variety. Relies heavily on direct engagement.
Boredom and lack of guard early in the fight may expose him to a quick technical knockout.

battle-dynamics.phase_1: Jiren strikes with full power, attempting to stifle the fight at the start. Saitama, fighting seriously, immediately enters escalation mode.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: An exchange of blows that shatters the fabric of reality around them. Jiren begins to lose his technical edge to pure strength.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Saitama reaches a level where Jiren's barriers simply crack. One serious blow ends the tournament match.
battle-dynamics.analysis: When Saitama fights seriously, Jiren only has a brief window to find a finish before Saitama outgrows him.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: Jiren imposes an absolute pace. A carefree Saitama takes hits that would eject gods from the ring, but he only waits for an opening.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Jiren executes hundreds of precise ki strikes. Saitama toys with the fight, allowing Jiren full control of the field.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: Saitama is pushed out of the field or technically knocked out before he can take the opponent seriously.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: Saitama's lack of seriousness is Jiren's only chance for a technical knockout victory.
battle-dynamics.s3_label: Fight to the Death · Serious Saitama
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_1: Jiren discards barriers and strikes to kill. Saitama responds in kind – zero games, only pure annihilation.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_2: Death rules remove limiters from both warriors. Saitama grows in power exponentially with each second of contact.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_3: Ultimate Serious Series. Saitama erases Jiren from existence before he can reload his ki.
battle-dynamics.s3_analysis: Under death rules, Saitama becomes a force of nature that no Jiren discipline can withstand.
battle-dynamics.s4_label: Fight to the Death · Casual Saitama
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_1: Jiren strikes with lethal intent. Saitama takes the blows with a smile, not yet understanding the stakes of the duel.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_2: The fight lasts long. Jiren burns his resources to kill someone who simply refuses to die.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_3: Even a carefree Saitama eventually strikes once, nonchalantly, which ends the life of a weary Jiren under death rules.
battle-dynamics.s4_analysis: Saitama's durability ensures that a fight to the death always ends in his win, even if he doesn't try.

fight-simulation.opening: Jiren opens the fight with a ki charge, attempting to immediately dominate the space.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Saitama counters with a series of normal punches that force Jiren's barriers to maximum effort.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Saitama delivers a Serious Punch, ending the clash in a blinding flash.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Saitama's victory by total breakthrough of the opponent's defense.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Jiren strikes at speeds exceeding time, but Saitama is already there to block him.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Thousands of punches per second create a field of pure destruction between the warriors.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Jiren finds a gap in Saitama's stance.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Saitama starts dictating the pace of the exchange.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Saitama strikes seriously. The shockwave tears apart clouds across the entire planet.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Jiren is thrown into deep space.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: Jiren falls, losing consciousness from exhaustion.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Jiren rains blows down on Saitama. Saitama allows it, seeking excitement in the fight.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: Jiren uses ki barriers to immobilize Saitama and push him out of the ring.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_a: Saitama yawns, which Jiren uses for a powerful thrust.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_b: Saitama tries to catch a fly, ignoring the attacks.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Jiren concentrates all ki into one shot that ejects Saitama from the ring.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: Saitama returns to the ring, but the fight time has expired.
fight-simulation.s2_end_condition: Jiren's victory through technical tournament points.
fight-simulation.s3_label: Fight to the Death · Serious Saitama
fight-simulation.s3_phase_1_event: Jiren strikes to kill. His fists carry energy capable of erasing galaxies.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_event: Saitama grows in strength so fast that Jiren ceases to understand what is happening.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_a: Jiren desperately tries to escalate power beyond his limits.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_b: Saitama copies and improves Jiren's fighting style on the fly.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_event: Saitama releases a punch that reverses causality. The fight ends before it even began.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_b: The universe is reset to the moment before the fight.
fight-simulation.s4_label: Fight to the Death · Casual Saitama
fight-simulation.s4_phase_1_event: Jiren strikes Saitama's chest with the full power of a God of Destruction. Saitama asks about supermarket sales.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_event: Jiren burns his entire essence, while Saitama still stands unmoved.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_a: Jiren loses faith in his own strength.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_event: Saitama performs one lazy punch to finally go home. It is enough.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_branch_a: Jiren dies from a single strike.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_branch_b: Jiren is reduced to an atomic level.
fight-simulation.s4_end_condition: Saitama's victory through absolute existential difference.

final-summary.line_1: Jiren is the peak of discipline and power within the laws of the universe, but Saitama is an anomaly that ignores those laws.
final-summary.line_2: Most scenarios end in Saitama's win, unless the fight is resolved on pure tournament points in the early phase.
final-summary.line_3: This is a clash of whether perfect technique and infinite ki can defeat a character whose only rule is the lack of any limits.
final-summary.winner: Saitama wins in almost every variant.
final-summary.quote: “Saitama has infinite potential. Jiren may not give him even a second to develop it... but that second can last an eternity.”

tactical-board.lane: Jiren must end the fight before Saitama starts taking it seriously.
tactical-board.subtitle: Discipline versus Limitlessness

verdict-matrix.subtitle: Verdict based on Jiren's initial output
verdict-matrix.case_1: Jiren 10/10. The scale difference at the start is too vast. If Jiren strikes with full power from the first second, Saitama is erased before his potential can even react to the new threat level. Saitama has never faced a power capable of shaking infinity.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Saitama 7/10. If Jiren allows the fight to proceed and slowly tests his opponent (as in the ToP), he gives Saitama time for non-linear growth. In this scenario, Saitama inevitably surpasses Jiren's power ceiling and takes control of the clash.

x-factor.implication: This is why Jiren can lead in stats and still lose the fight through Saitama's non-linear growth.
x-factor.mechanics: Jiren needs only one clean finish window, but Saitama is a gag character who ignores fight mathematics.
x-factor.psychology: Jiren wants the fight resolved immediately. Saitama wants to feel a thrill, which paradoxically weakens him at the start.
x-factor.example: Jiren strikes Saitama a thousand times in a second. Instead of falling, Saitama begins to grow in strength so fast that Jiren loses contact with reality.
x-factor.question: Is Jiren able to land a blow powerful enough to knock out Saitama before his limiter breaks for good?
